newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Argentine cash maize down, traders watch weather.
newsitem.headline: Argentine cash maize down, traders watch weather.

text.p: Argentine cash maize dipped in middling midsession trade at the Buenos Aires Cereals Exchange, with prices dragged down by the fall in Chicago, but traders remained nervous over the lack of rain in Argentina, traders said.
Concern about the dryness affecting sowing also kept soybeans up.

Prices were mainly steady in thin trade despite a fall on the CBOT. Wheat prices dipped in middling turnover, with international prices down but local concern about northern yields. Cash sunflower seed was steady to weaker in slow trade. Soy prices were dragging down, but committments from oil sales mean crushers must buy.
